name: ofw-mcp
description: OurFamilyWizard co-parenting tools for Claude — messages, calendar, expenses, and journal

ofw_username.title: OFW Email
ofw_username.description: Your OurFamilyWizard login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to the fetchproxy browser extension (requires being signed in to ourfamilywizard.com in your browser).

ofw_password.title: OFW Password
ofw_password.description: Your OurFamilyWizard password. Optional — see ofw_username.

ofw_inline_attachments.title: Return attachments inline
ofw_inline_attachments.description: When on, ofw_download_attachment returns bytes inline as MCP content (images render directly; other files come back as embedded resources) instead of writing to disk. Recommended for sandboxed hosts like Claude Desktop where the model cannot read files written to ~/Downloads. Callers can still override per-call via the tool's `inline` argument.

ofw_attachments_dir.title: Attachments download directory
ofw_attachments_dir.description: Directory where ofw_download_attachment writes files when not returning inline. Defaults to ~/Downloads/ofw-mcp/. Pick a directory that is readable by your MCP host. Downloads can only be written inside it.

ofw_upload_dir.title: Upload source directory
ofw_upload_dir.description: The only directory ofw_upload_attachment may upload files from (hidden files excluded). Defaults to the attachments download directory. Put files you want to send to OurFamilyWizard here.

ofw_write_mode.title: Write mode
ofw_write_mode.description: Structural write gate. "none" = no write tools registered (read/sync/search only); "drafts" = draft-level writes only (save/delete drafts, upload attachments — never send or calendar/expense/journal writes); "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

ofw_calendar_writes.title: Calendar writes in drafts mode
ofw_calendar_writes.description: When Write mode is "drafts", also register the calendar write tools (create/update/delete event). Calendar events have no draft stage but are reversible (editable/deletable), unlike a sent message. Redundant in "all"; never overrides "none".

ofw_allow_mark_read.title: Allow marking messages read
ofw_allow_mark_read.description: Reading a message body for the first time marks it READ on OurFamilyWizard and stamps a "First Viewed" time your co-parent can see - part of the record, and irreversible. Leave on for the long-standing behaviour; turn off to forbid it entirely (no per-call argument can override).

ofw_fetch_unread_bodies.title: Sync unread message bodies
ofw_fetch_unread_bodies.description: Whether a sync also downloads unread inbox bodies by default. Each one stamps a "First Viewed" time. Off by default; ignored when "Allow marking messages read" is off.

ofw_expense_only.title: Expense-only mode
ofw_expense_only.description: Structural restriction: register only healthcheck plus expense tools. Removes profile/dashboard, messages, calendar, and journal tools entirely.

ofw_expense_upload_only.title: Expense upload-only mode
ofw_expense_upload_only.description: Strict structural restriction: register only healthcheck, ofw_upload_expense_pdf, ofw_create_expense, and ofw_update_expense. Implies Expense-only mode and removes expense reads too.

ofw_cache_identity.title: Cache identity label (advanced)
ofw_cache_identity.description: Explicit cache-key label; overrides OFW_USERNAME for fetchproxy-only multi-account setups. If you have multiple OFW accounts and want them to use separate caches, set it to a label per profile.

ofw_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable browser bridge (advanced)
ofw_disable_fetchproxy.description: Skip the fetchproxy fallback, so missing credentials become a hard error (useful in headless CI).

ofw_session_cache.title: Cache the session between runs
ofw_session_cache.description: Cache the OFW session between runs (default on). Turn off and a restart re-authenticates every time.

ofw_session_file.title: Session cache file (advanced)
ofw_session_file.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.ofw-mcp/session.json.

ofw_auto_refresh.title: Auto-refresh empty stale reads
ofw_auto_refresh.description: When a cached read comes back EMPTY from a non-fresh cache, the read tools sync the backing folders and answer from the refreshed cache instead of refusing with UNVERIFIED_EMPTY (default off, i.e. refuse). Per-call autoRefresh overrides it. A refresh that does not make the read verifiable still refuses.

ofw_freshness_ttl_seconds.title: Freshness window in seconds (advanced)
ofw_freshness_ttl_seconds.description: How long a verified-against-OFW folder stays labelled `fresh` in read tools' `freshness` block (default 300). Unusable values fall back to the default — a typo must never widen the window in which stale data reads as current.

ofw_sync_max_requests.title: Sync request budget (advanced)
ofw_sync_max_requests.description: Per-call OFW-request budget for ofw_sync_messages: a positive integer caps how many OFW requests one sync call may make before pausing; the next call resumes where it left off. Unset means unbounded (local installs walk fully in one call).

ofw_request_timeout_ms.title: Request timeout in ms (advanced)
ofw_request_timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout for OFW API calls, in milliseconds (default 30000). Each retry gets its own fresh window.

ofw_debug_log.title: Debug logging (diagnostic)
ofw_debug_log.description: Log every OFW request/response to stderr (Authorization redacted). Diagnostic only.

display_tz.title: Display time zone
display_tz.description: IANA zone (e.g. America/New_York, the default) for every `<field>Display` value, and the zone a NAIVE source timestamp is assumed to be wall-clock in. OFW's API reports naive local times in the account's own zone, so this must match it. Unrecognized values fall back to the default.

fetchproxy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy port (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_port.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: fetchproxy bind address (advanced)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: fetchproxy identity directory (advanced)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).

tools.description: Get dashboard summary: unread messages, upcoming events, outstanding expenses

tools.description: Read a message by ID

tools.name: ofw_send_message
tools.description: Send a message (confirmed first, with a preview of recipients, subject and body)

tools.name: ofw_list_drafts
tools.description: List draft messages

tools.description: Create or update a draft

tools.name: ofw_delete_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft

tools.name: ofw_get_unread_sent
tools.description: List sent messages the co-parent has not yet viewed

tools.name: ofw_upload_attachment
tools.description: Upload a file from disk to use as an attachment on a message or draft (sharing it with the co-parent is confirmed first)

tools.name: ofw_download_attachment
tools.description: Download a message attachment by fileId — returns bytes inline or writes to disk

tools.name: ofw_sync_messages
tools.description: Sync messages from OFW into local cache

tools.name: ofw_list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a date range

tools.name: ofw_create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event (a shared one is confirmed first)

tools.name: ofw_update_event
tools.description: Update a calendar event (a shared one is confirmed first)

tools.name: ofw_delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event (a shared one is confirmed first)

tools.name: ofw_get_expense_totals
tools.description: Get expense summary totals

tools.name: ofw_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses

tools.description: List expense categories (preset and custom) with their split metadata

tools.name: ofw_list_journal_entries

tools.name: ofw_check_freshness
tools.description: Cheaply re-verify message/draft ids against OFW — live lifecycle state and content-hash comparison, no bodies fetched

tools.name: ofw_status
tools.description: Server-verified draft inventory and live lifecycle state for given ids or draft keys, in one round trip
